title: About Plan Well
subtitle: Plan Well is a personalized Indian nutrition planner that generates science-based 7-day meal plans tailored to your weight, dietary preferences, location, and lifestyle to support healthier eating habits and sustainable weight-loss goals.

sections.title: About Plan Well
content: Plan Well is a modern nutrition planning web application built to simplify healthy eating through personalized Indian meal planning.
The application generates a customized 7-day meal plan based on your weight, state or union territory, dietary preference, meals per day, and optional protein supplement information.

Instead of providing generic meal suggestions, Plan Well creates structured meal plans with portion guidance, nutritional summaries, and a balanced weekly schedule tailored to your selected preferences.
The project combines an intuitive user experience with secure cloud storage, allowing users to generate, save, revisit, and manage their meal plans from anywhere.

sections.title: Who Can Use Plan Well?
content: Plan Well is designed for anyone who wants a simple and organized way to plan healthier meals without spending hours creating meal schedules manually.

Whether you are beginning a weight-loss journey, improving your eating habits, maintaining a healthy lifestyle, or simply looking for structured Indian meal planning, Plan Well provides an easy starting point.

sections.title: Key Features
content: Plan Well combines personalized meal planning with modern web technologies to provide a smooth and user-friendly experience.
bullets: State and Union Territory based recommendations
View and manage previously saved meal plans
Responsive interface for desktop and mobile
Real-time validation with helpful error messages
Smooth loading experience during meal generation

sections.title: How to Use
content: Generating a meal plan is quick and straightforward. You may use the application without signing in, or sign in with Google to automatically save your plans.

Enter your weight, choose your state or union territory, select your dietary preference, choose the number of meals per day, and optionally provide protein supplement information if you use supplements.
Plan Well generates a personalized weekly meal plan, displays nutritional summaries, and allows signed-in users to revisit or download their meal plans whenever required.
bullets: Download the meal plan as PDF
Delete saved meal plans whenever needed

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
bullets: Do I need to sign in? No. You can generate meal plans without signing in. Signing in allows your meal plans to be securely saved to your account.
Can I generate multiple meal plans? Yes. There is no limit to the number of meal plans you can create.
Can I use protein supplements? Yes. You can optionally provide nutritional information for supported protein supplements so they can be incorporated into your meal plan.
Can I download my meal plan? Yes. Generated meal plans can be downloaded as a PDF.
Are my saved meal plans private? Yes. Saved meal plans are associated only with your authenticated Google account.
Can I delete saved meal plans? Yes. You may delete any saved meal plan at any time.
Can I create meal plans for different states? Yes. Simply choose a different state or union territory before generating a new plan.

sections.title: Technologies Used
content: Plan Well was developed using a modern full-stack web development stack focused on performance, scalability, and user experience.

sections.title: About the Developer
content: Plan Well was developed as a portfolio project to demonstrate the design and development of a complete full-stack web application focused on personalized nutrition planning.

The project showcases responsive user interface design, secure authentication, cloud database integration, personalized recommendation logic, PDF generation, and an overall production-quality user experience.
The application emphasizes simplicity, usability, and practical meal planning while demonstrating modern web development best practices.

sections.title: Disclaimer
content: Plan Well is intended to assist users with structured meal planning and healthier eating habits.
The meal plans generated by the application are provided for educational and informational purposes only and should not be considered medical, nutritional, or professional healthcare advice.

Nutrition requirements vary between individuals. If you have medical conditions, allergies, dietary restrictions, or specific health concerns, consult a qualified healthcare professional or registered dietitian before making significant dietary changes.
Users are responsible for verifying ingredients, allergies, and nutritional suitability before following any meal plan.
